content: If the bits Partial Network Learning and Repeat Message Request both are received on a channel where FrNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and FrNm is in the Network Mode the FrNm module shall set the Parti al Network Learning Bit in the CBV to 1 on this channel and change to or restart the Repeat Message State at the end of a NM Specification of FlexRay Network Management AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 30 of 137 Document ID 28 : AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement Repetition Cycle.

If the bits Partial Network Learning and Repeat Message Request both are received on a channel where FrNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and FrNm is in the Network Mode the FrNm module shall set the Parti al Network Learning Bit in the CBV to 1 on this channel and change to or restart the Repeat Message State at the end of a NM Specification of FlexRay Network Mana gement AU TOS AR CP R22 - 11 30 of 139 Document ID 28 : AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayNetworkManage ment Repetition Cycle.
